name: Rajratan Global Wire Ltd
title: Rajratan Global Wire Ltd - 517522 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin dipped on a ~INR10,000/t steel spike not passed through until April; management guides 13-14% sustainable margin and ~17-18% FY27 volume growth to ~155,000t, while Chennai capacity doubles to 60,000t amid admitted industry overcapacity.

utilisation.quote: Chennai reached peak in the month of March, which was 85% to 90% of installed capacity.

capex.peers_comment: Management said current capacity is much more than demand and some global players may not survive.
capex.quote: we have decided to put in balancing machines to double the capacity

triggers.label: Chennai capacity 30,000t → 60,000t
triggers.quote: we will become a 60,000 tons capacity plant by second quarter of this financial year

triggers.label: Price hike passed on from April
triggers.quote: we have been able to pass on the price increase in the current quarter

triggers.label: Capacity exceeds demand; consolidation
triggers.quote: Currently capacity is much more than the demand.

triggers.label: Raw material share 57% → 63%
triggers.quote: If you look at our raw material consumption percentage from 57% has gone to 63% in the current quarter.

triggers.label: Tyre market share back to 42-43%
triggers.quote: our market share has again reached to 42% to 43%, which had come down to 35% to 37%

guidance.quote: You can continue to assume that we will be able to maintain this EBITDA level 13.5% to 14% safely.
next year you can estimate a 155,000 tons of total sales if things remain normal globally.
Thailand from current year volume which is close to 51,000 will grow to 55,000 to 56,000.
Next year probably we are expecting to touch about 15,000 tons of export from India.

prior_guidance_check.quote: the margin dip is purely because of the sudden increase in wire rod price

red_flags.label: Q4 EBITDA miss; RM cost not passed through
red_flags.quote: we could not achieve the EBITDA targeted EBITDA. That is because of the high prices of raw material.

red_flags.label: Rising debt and working capital
red_flags.quote: we don't expect any reduction in working capital requirement, rather we see some more requirement of working capital.

red_flags.label: PLI targets missed, benefit uncertain
red_flags.quote: first year target -- targeted production as committed to them and second year targeted production was also not achieved

evasions.quote: I think we'll give you this answer separately. I don't have that calculation right now.
Don't expect us to tell you everything.
Specific things are very difficult to commit today.
